search-page.eventDescription: KvK Search Page: charged for each request the scraper sends to the KVK Handelsregister API, including the initial search and every additional page of results that gets fetched. A larger pageSize reduces the number of requests needed for the same dataset.

retry.eventDescription: Charged each time a failed request is automatically retried. Retries protect your run against transient network issues and KVK rate-limiting; you only see this charge if a request initially fails.

proxy-datacenter.eventDescription: Charged once per run when you enable Apify Proxy without a specific proxy group. Use this when scraping from a clean datacenter IP is enough to avoid blocks. Disable proxy in the input to skip this charge.

proxy-residential.eventDescription: Charged once per run when you enable Apify Proxy with a proxy group such as RESIDENTIAL. Residential IPs are more expensive but significantly reduce blocking on aggressive anti-bot setups. Switch to no proxy or basic proxy to avoid this charge.
